title: An Grianan Theatre
geometryBasis: The named mapped outline, the exact cleared public-domain photograph of the glass façade and the theatre’s own dates and stage dimensions.
sectionBasis: The Port Road façade combines a deep eaved gable, a tall rectilinear curtain wall, exposed diagonal roof ties and an enclosed central porch. The rear contains the auditorium and full-height fly stage.
limitations: The front colours and entrance represent the cleared 2007 image before the 2014 renovations.
The rear and secondary wings follow the mapped outline. Unpublished exterior heights, cladding and openings are approximate.
